hint.en: Will control thermostats in the same zone. This is achieved by setting the target temperature above / below the measured temperature.
hint.no: Styrer termostater i samme sone ved å justere måltemperaturen over/under målt romtemperatur.
hint.nl: Bedient thermostaten in dezelfde zone door de doeltemperatuur boven/onder de gemeten temperatuur in te stellen.
